title: Tessl Review: Turn Engineering Standards into Review Rubrics
description:
How do you ensure AI-generated changes meet your engineering standards? Tessl Review offers a consistent, repeatable framework to evaluate AI code, specs, and changes against your organization’s specific requirements. Not relying on subjective opinions or generic feedback, but on standards that keep your delivery sharp. 

Mark, a product manager at Tessl, explores these dynamics alongside Gareth, an engineering lead. They bring depth to the discussion, highlighting real challenges faced by teams scaling their AI development. They unpack how Tessl Review allows customization of review rubrics to match unique architectural and quality standards, reinforcing the control teams have over their AI-driven processes.

What we cover:
• Why traditional code review breaks down with AI-generated changes
• How can custom review rubrics enforce engineering standards?
• Evaluating AI changes against architecture and quality criteria
• Building confidence in software quality before production
